title: Scheme-density comparison for the enlarged etale site
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and work with algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], with every site small relative to its sheaves. Use chartwise etale morphisms as in [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence]: every representable etale scheme chart remains representable etale after composition. For a space $A$, let $\mathcal C_A$ have objects chartwise etale maps $T\to A$ from algebraic spaces, arrows all maps over $A$, and coverings jointly surjective chartwise etale families [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Write $i_A:A_{\mathrm{et}}\to\mathcal C_A$ for the scheme-object inclusion, regarding schemes as their representable sheaves [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]. For every space $X$, these coverings satisfy the site axioms. The object $X/X$ is terminal and sheaf fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers] give pullbacks in $\mathcal C_X$; in particular $\mathcal C_X$ has finite limits. Coverings between scheme objects are exactly the small etale coverings. The functor $i_X$ is fully faithful and continuous. Every covering $\{T_j\to i_X(U)\}$ admits a refinement by a covering $\{i_X(W_j)\to i_X(U)\}$ obtained from surjective representable etale scheme charts $W_j\to T_j$. Every object of $\mathcal C_X$ has a singleton covering by a scheme object. Thus $i_X$ satisfies all five conditions of a special cocontinuous functor [def-weil-pbc-special-cocontinuous-functor], including local fullness and local faithfulness. Restriction $i_X^*:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C_X)\to\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}})$ is an equivalence of categories of sheaves of sets.

source.place: Tags 03G0 (definition-spaces-etale-site), 03G1 (lemma-compare-etale-sites); finite limits in Tag 03G2 (lemma-functoriality-etale-site), proof; chartwise convention Tag 03FR (definition-etale).

proof.text: Use chartwise permanence to make every arrow over X chartwise etale by cancellation. Construct X/X and prove its terminal universal property. Bundle the actual sheaf pullback of two arrows as an enlarged object: its projection is chartwise etale by base change and its structure map by composition. Reflect its presheaf pullback square through the fully faithful forgetful functors. Singleton isomorphisms lift sections by their inverse; composition uses the presheaf field-extension family calculus. For base change, apply the evaluated sheaf pullback universal property to a restricted target section and the original lifted section. These prove the three site axioms, including empty covers. Terminal object and pullbacks give finite limits.

Compare pointwise scheme surjectivity and field-extension lifting for any indexed scheme family. In one direction test the residue-field map at a point and evaluate the lifted field-valued map at its unique point. Conversely choose a source point over the image of a given field-valued map. The compatible-point theorem gives a point of the scheme fibre product with Spec K. The residue field at that point and the map from its spectrum give a field extension K to L and the required lift, with its over-S equation. Comparison maps between scheme objects etale over X are etale by representable_etale_scheme_tests. Reindex an arbitrary presieve by its arrows to conclude exact covering agreement.

Construct the fully faithful structure on scheme inclusion explicitly. For an enlarged-site arrow between scheme objects take the Yoneda preimage of its underlying natural transformation. The equation over X transports unchanged. Yoneda map_preimage and preimage_map prove the two inverse identities.

Construct the scheme fibre product of two small-site arrows, whose second projection is etale by scheme base change. Its composite to X is representable etale, so it is a small-site object. Yoneda preserves the scheme pullback and the enlarged forgetful functor reflects it, proving that inclusion preserves this pullback. For a generating small covering pulled back along an arbitrary arrow, its included family covers by enlarged base change and hence covers in the small site by step 2. Apply the sheaf criterion for a generated precoverage and the equivalence of sheaf conditions under preservation of pairwise pullbacks. This proves continuity without any extra precoverage instances.

Choose a representable surjective etale scheme atlas of the source algebraic space of an enlarged object. The chartwise condition of its structure map makes the composite into X representable etale, giving the small-site object. For any field-valued section, the atlas scheme test is a surjective scheme over Spec K. Choose a point above the unique point of Spec K and take its residue-field map. Yoneda evaluation of the representing pullback equality proves the lift equation after that field extension. Thus the atlas is a singleton enlarged covering.

Choose the singleton atlases of step 5 for each member of an enlarged covering of a scheme object. Full faithfulness lifts their composites to small-site arrows. The presheaf family composition calculus makes the composite family field-point surjective, and step 2 makes it a small covering. This keeps the original index set, including the empty set. Show by induction on precoverage saturation that each covering sieve contains an actual covering presieve, using the three enlarged site axioms. Refine that presieve by the preceding atlases; its small covering lies in the functor pullback sieve. This is cocontinuity.

Use the identity singleton small cover, which covers by step 2 and the enlarged isomorphism axiom. Faithfulness gives equality of parallel arrows with equal image; fullness lifts an arrow between image objects. These prove the two local conditions. Steps 2, 4, 5, and 6 give cover preservation, preservation of covering pullbacks, covering by image objects, and cocontinuity. Assemble exactly the special cocontinuous covering predicate.

The singleton atlases give Mathlib IsCoverDense. Fullness and faithfulness give local fullness and local faithfulness. Continuity makes inclusion preserve covering sieves. Conversely cocontinuity makes the pullback of an image covering sieve cover, and full faithfulness identifies that pullback with the original sieve. These are IsDenseSubsite. Apply the existing Mathlib dense-subsite restriction equivalence, with coefficient universe max (u+1) w so all required comma-category limits exist. The resulting sheafPushforwardContinuous is definitionally enlargedRestriction. This is the sieve formulation of the same Stacks 03A0 comparison and avoids the small-category-only signature of specialCocontinuous_sheafEquivalence.

lean.statement: theorem enlargedSite_scheme_density {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) : X.enlargedEtalePrecoverage.IsSiteForCoverings ∧ (∃ T : X.EnlargedEtaleSite, T.obj = Over.mk (𝟙 X) ∧ Nonempty (IsTerminal T)) ∧ (∀ (T U V : X.EnlargedEtaleSite) (f : T ⟶ V) (g : U ⟶ V), ∃ (P : X.EnlargedEtaleSite) (p : P ⟶ T) (q : P ⟶ U), IsPullback p q f g ∧ IsPullback p.hom.left.hom q.hom.left.hom f.hom.left.hom g.hom.left.hom) ∧ Nonempty (HasFiniteLimits X.EnlargedEtaleSite) ∧ (∀ (U : X.EtaleSite) (R : Presieve U), R ∈ X.etalePrecoverage U ↔ R.map (enlargedSchemeInclusion X) ∈ X.enlargedEtalePrecoverage ((enlargedSchemeInclusion X).obj U)) ∧ Nonempty (enlargedSchemeInclusion X).FullyFaithful ∧ (enlargedSchemeInclusion X).IsContinuous X.etaleTopology X.enlargedEtaleTopology ∧ (∀ (I : Type v) (U : X.EtaleSite) (T : I → X.EnlargedEtaleSite) (f : ∀ i : I, T i ⟶ (enlargedSchemeInclusion X).obj U), Presieve.ofArrows T f ∈ X.enlargedEtalePrecoverage ((enlargedSchemeInclusion X).obj U) → ∃ (W : I → X.EtaleSite) (a : ∀ i : I, (enlargedSchemeInclusion X).obj (W i) ⟶ T i) (b : ∀ i : I, W i ⟶ U), (∀ i : I, IsEtale (a i).hom.left.hom.hom ∧ IsSurjective (a i).hom.left.hom.hom) ∧ (∀ i : I, (enlargedSchemeInclusion X).map (b i) = a i ≫ f i) ∧ Presieve.ofArrows W b ∈ X.etalePrecoverage U) ∧ (∀ T : X.EnlargedEtaleSite, ∃ (W : X.EtaleSite) (a : (enlargedSchemeInclusion X).obj W ⟶ T), IsEtale a.hom.left.hom.hom ∧ IsSurjective a.hom.left.hom.hom ∧ Presieve.singleton a ∈ X.enlargedEtalePrecoverage T) ∧ (enlargedSchemeInclusion X).IsSpecialCocontinuousForCoverings X.etalePrecoverage X.enlargedEtalePrecoverage ∧ (enlargedRestriction X (Type (max (u + 1) w))).IsEquivalence
